canonicalChecks.classification: lexical source binding, not dynamic reachability/equivalence

sourceReasoning.conclusion: favorStraightEdges true and FixedAlignment.NONE disable balanced averaging; IMPROVE_STRAIGHTNESS selects active SimpleThresholdStrategy. Preserve exact list/evaluation order right-down,right-up,left-down,left-up. Generated allocation statements create left-down,left-up,right-down,right-up before that list order; this allocation detail must not be confused with chosen-layout tie order. Logging branches remain out of scope.

Actual final layer/node order assigns global node IDs and layer IDs, then ordered incoming/outgoing edge traversal produces max-priority neighbor pairs with stable local-index sort. Source default priority0 does not make neighbors a set. Keep connecting edge identity as well as neighbor node; source inner-segment conflict detection is real for LONG_EDGE chains.

The sweep starts with layers index2 and scans actual interior predecessors. It tracks literal k0/k1/l boundaries and marks concrete edge identities outside the current inner-segment interval. Diamonds/multiple inner chains cannot inherit E04 no-conflict reduction; only source numberOfLayers<3 is an early return.

For all four layouts, initialize actual root/align/innerShift, traverse layers/nodes by direction, inspect floor/ceil median neighbors in the source direction, and honor marked edges plus strict r comparisons. Root-alignment cycle writes and od booleans remain real; no generic barycenter or topology placement can replace this family.

LinkedHashMap getBlocks uses first source layer traversal insertion order and actual root identities. Each block follows align cycle and first ordered connecting edge; portPosDiff uses the literal four operand add/sub expression, then inner shifts accumulate and spaceAbove/Below include real margins. Tiny positive NORMAL margin and dummy height1/port.y0 must survive; port center and margin0 shortcuts are invalid.

y[root]=0 is a memoization write before recursive neighbor placement. calculateThreshold occurs after neighbor recursion, or directly if no neighbor. Sink first-assignment, UP/DOWN required-space association and min/max preserve source order. Different sink classes use graph nodeNode spacing, not pair-type spacing. Subsequent layers/root positions and sink class shifts are actually propagated.

The fixed worker HashMap backing is ECMAScript Map; private LNode identity hash values are unique within bounded work objects. No deletion or string-key insertion happens in sinkNodes. Map entry iteration followed by collision chain therefore yields insertion order, justifying host identity-key dict rather than importing a generic Java HashMap assumption. Class indegrees include every actual outgoing constraint, initial indegree0 sinks use that order, and propagation is FIFO.

Active threshold reads blockFinished and searches first eligible finished-other-root edge in actual incoming/outgoing order; preserve the duplicated same-root su predicate literally. Root/last eligibility and isNaN/isFinite gates apply to infinities, with no added EPS. Unfinished work uses queue FIFO, then unsuccessful first tries use stack LIFO and retry process83. Its delta test uses strict positive/negative and Double.MAX_VALUE, followed by actual checkSpaceAbove/Below and shiftBlock.

NORMAL/NORMAL uses effective nodeNode, NORMAL/LONG_EDGE uses edgeNode10, LONG_EDGE/LONG_EDGE uses edgeEdge10 under default individual-spacing absence. Port scalar positions and anchor values enter block/threshold formulas directly. Class propagation graph spacing remains separate. Empty business nested keys do not become option overrides.

Strict top>previousBottom AND bottom>previousBottom feasibility is retained even for zero size/zero spacing. First strictly smaller feasible layout wins fixed list order; if none is feasible, source falls back to first right-down instead of raising an invented error or changing comparisons. layoutSize uses y plus root blockSize; final node.y is chosen y+innerShift without translation. Scratch disposal is per call.

Phase checks flat proper8layers/64nodes/84segments/168ports, ordered NORMAL/LONG_EDGE, real finite coordinates/margins and reviewed default choices. Integer indexes/counts are safely bounded; coordinates remain IEEE64 in source association, with explicit infinity/MAX_VALUE sentinels and signed-zero min/max semantics. No RNG entry occurs in this retained helper family. Original8→internal64 depends on separately accepted NS-G4/G6 and splitter, and unapproved NodeSize/export remain external dependencies rather than being silently accepted.

limitations: Manual source and guard review plus reproducible lexical binding checks; this is not automatic proof of mathematical equivalence or runtime correctness.
